reply.text:
Three things do most of the work: overhead pressing, lateral raises, and rear delt work like face pulls or reverse flyes. Most people under-train the side and rear delts, and those are what give shoulders width and roundness.

A good starting point is 2 to 3 shoulder sessions' worth of work a week, around 10 to 15 hard sets total. Keep most sets 2 or 3 reps shy of failure, and add a rep or a little weight over time. Lateral raises respond well to higher reps (12 to 20) with controlled form, no swinging.

If you want, I can build you a program with a shoulder focus, or a single shoulder day for today. Just say which.
